caption:
Closing for December? Your clients' calls don't stop. 📞🎄

With public holidays on 16, 25 and 26 December and 1 January, plus the usual year-end break, many offices sit empty for weeks. Here's how to make sure no call goes unanswered:

✅ Ring your cellphone: our app puts your office line on your phone
✅ Set a holiday greeting with your closing and return dates
✅ Send voicemail to email so nothing gets lost
✅ Use a ring group so calls go to whoever is on duty
✅ Keep it crystal clear: on a decent connection, app calls sound as good as your desk phone
